capabilities: Display current weather in the statusbar
Insert weather strings into documents via commands
Replace template placeholders (%weather1%-%weather4%) when creating new documents
Render dynamic, auto-updating weather in DIV blocks
Configure location, units, language and update frequency
extras: Explicitly discontinued: the OpenWeather API 2.5 it depends on has been discontinued and could stop returning data at any time; the author directs users to the successor Visual Crossing Weather plugin, which at the time was a beta work in progress with almost no documentation and could be installed manually or via the BRAT plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display current weather or automatically insert it into notes and daily templates.

relations.evidence: If you want to try the new plugin now you can find the Visual Crossing Weather plugin here.
A free OpenWeather API key is required for the plugin to work.

summary: Weather plugin that fetches current conditions and a 5-day forecast from OpenWeather and renders them via customizable strings in the statusbar and notes.
